content.short: Foreign accounts, transfers, FX and virtual cards.
content.description: Grey, formerly Aboki Africa and backed by Y Combinator, is a cross-border money platform for Africans, freelancers, and remote workers who earn or spend in foreign currencies. It gives users foreign bank accounts in USD, GBP, and EUR to receive international payments, competitive currency exchange, fast transfers, and virtual dollar cards for online spending. Grey also supports converting between fiat and stablecoins to move value globally and hedge against local currency volatility, with dedicated products for individuals and, through Grey Business, for African startups and SMEs. By combining foreign accounts, FX, and cards in one app, Grey helps users in Nigeria and beyond get paid from abroad and manage international money more easily.
content.meta: Grey offers foreign accounts, FX, transfers, and virtual cards for Africans globally. Discover Grey and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
